# Anne & Rilla Blythe

- [Rilla Blythe](../character/rilla-blythe.md) — Child of — [Anne](../character/anne.md) — mother · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P20](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0020)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) approaches [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) while [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) sit on the veranda chatting after Anne's return from [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). [Susan](../character/susan.md) watches over six-year-old [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) and baby [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) while recounting recent local gossip to [Anne](../character/anne.md), including an incident involving Mrs. Harrison Miller.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Miss Cornelia finish their conversation about their return from [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), music lessons for the children, and local news regarding [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) and the Ford family. Miss Cornelia departs after voicing her disapproval of Owen Ford's travel plans, leaving [Anne](../character/anne.md) to sit on the veranda steps and enjoy the evening moonrise over [Four Winds Harbour](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP

> [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) sets out to deliver a basket of strawberries to the manse, but [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) frightens her and chases her back down the street with a dried codfish. Miss Cornelia rescues the terrified and muddy child and brings her home, where she and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discuss the local children and gossip about potential wives for the minister.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE

> [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) become terrified in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) when they mistake Mrs. [Stimson](../character/stimson.md)—who is crawling on the [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) garden dyke with white sheets on her shoulders looking for a knitting needle—for the ghost of [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md). Terrified, the Meredith children sprint to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), where [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) soothe them. [Susan](../character/susan.md) investigates with a pitchfork and returns to explain the embarrassing truth, prompting the children to retreat home in shame.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE
